proposals.evidence: DEDR533 explicitly gives Alu Kurumba īpi and Irula īppi fly. Survey yippi in Alu and Betta Kurumba is a comparative noun-family match with initial glide and gemination retained; the gloss here denotes the insect, not flight. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
